ideas.pitch: A direct contribution to BossConsole adding BPMN-based workflow orchestration and human-in-the-loop approval gates specifically designed for multi-agent harness governance.
ideas.title: BossConsole BPMN Workflow Visualizer and Human-in-the-Loop Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core repo requirements of BossConsole by shipping a major agent workflow integration, aligning perfectly with what judges value for usefulness and relevance.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router plugin for BossConsole that dynamically routes agent task handoffs to the most cost-effective local or remote LLM based on embedding similarity.
ideas.title: BossConsole Semantic LLM Router for Multi-Agent Handoffs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven patterns from semantic routing hacks while delivering an immediate, high-impact developer experience upgrade to BossConsole's execution pipeline.

ideas.pitch: An audit and data lineage extension for BossConsole that requires agents to present an evidence gate and verified repair log before executing production-destined writebacks.
ideas.title: BossConsole Data-Lineage and Evidence Gate for Autonomous Agent Actions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves real data integrity pain points in multi-agent execution environments, matching the sophisticated engineering standards of previous grand prize-winning data-agent integrations.

ideas.pitch: A built-in testing harness extension for BossConsole that pits two competing AI agents against each other in game-theoretic scenarios to stress-test prompt robustness and failure recovery.
ideas.title: BossConsole Adversarial Agent Benchmarking Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates high technical ownership and creative depth, appealing directly to judges looking for original developer-experience and agent safety upgrades.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-acceleration wrapper for BossConsole allowing developers to run agent steps locally via Snapdragon NPUs for zero-latency, offline agent operations.
ideas.title: BossConsole Snapdragon NPU Local Model Inference Plugin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings unique hardware optimization to an open-source agent harness, satisfying the judges' criteria for originality and high-effort utility.
